meta.description: Predict enhancer-gene regulatory connections from ATAC-seq using ABC, ENCODE-rE2G, HiChIP, or Cicero; choose contact-aware, accessibility-only or orthogonal approaches, threshold and validate predictions.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; the avg-Hi-C branch is labelled as run on a same-cell-type substitute and the real 58 GB average as not executed; synthetic HiChIP loops are labelled with planted truth.

practice_boundaries.detail: Predictions are framed as hypotheses; therapeutic nomination requires two methods plus CRISPRi validation.

methodological_ground.detail: Outputs reproduce ABC's own expected tables exactly; candidate regions, quantile normalisation, calibrated thresholds and promoter handling now follow ABC.

code_usability.detail: run_abc.sh and combine_predictions.py run end to end on real K562 chr22 inputs; the prior P0 crash does not reproduce.

functional_suitability.note: Matched-Hi-C, powerlaw, accessibility-only and avg-mechanics paths execute; thresholds and rE2G routing accurate; juicebox/bedpe branches and real avg Hi-C unexecuted

reliability.note: Input guards fail fast with messages; reruns match ABC's own tables; ABC v1.1.2 CRLF threshold file leaves CR in output names (EGL-013)

performance_context.note: Lean SKILL.md with detail routed to two references; method-reference prose is dense

agent_usability.note: Clear method table, documented env vars, tested example with expected counts; macs2 shim knowledge lives only in the usage guide

human_usability.note: Natural request examples and a copy-paste example that reproduces the ABC chr22 result

security.note: Variables quoted, no destructive commands; remote Hi-C URL and git clones are unauthenticated downloads without checksums

maintainability.note: Parameterised script with documented header and a real-key combine script; no shipped tests; upstream layout drift is a standing risk

agent_specific.note: Routing and provenance good; stale claims removed; description is long; avg branch on real data is labelled unexecuted

key_strengths: The prior P0 is fixed: the documented usage example runs end to end in one command and reproduces ABC's own chr22 K562 tables exactly (1,674,535 rows, 1,353 links at 0.027).

Hi-C, powerlaw, accessibility-only, MACS3-peaks and avg-mechanics branches execute with calibrated thresholds and correct promoter handling; the avg branch is honestly labelled as run on a substitute.
combine_predictions.py uses the real column keys and detects planted HiChIP loops in both orientations without decoys.
Fail-fast input guards and routed references keep SKILL.md lean and consistent with executed behaviour.

recommendations.title: CR left in threshold on ABC v1.1.2 (CRLF table)
recommendations.problem: On the v1.1.2 tag abc_thresholds.tsv has CRLF endings, so the awk lookup keeps a carriage return and output files are named threshold0.017<CR>.tsv; scores are still correct.
recommendations.root_cause: The awk lookup prints field 4 without stripping CR, while the header claims v1.1.2 is tested.
recommendations.fix: Pipe the lookup through tr -d '\r' and rerun the v1.1.2 powerlaw case. (EGL-013)
